numerical_laws.RHE: Signed exact rational round-half-even; increment is rounded before addition.
numerical_laws.GT: R_next=clamp(R+RHE(K_fp*(Y-E)/Q),0,Q); admitted binary Y is 0 or Q; E is original prospective expectation.
numerical_laws.half_life: H=clamp(RHE(86400*(Q/2+R)*regret_factor*Q*safety_factor/Q^4),3600,604800). regret_factor=Q-regret_norm_fp when KNOWN, otherwise Q/2. safety_factor=Q/2 for VERIFIED_UNSAFE, otherwise Q.
numerical_laws.decay: T(t)=RHE(R*2^(-age/H)); anchor=min(history_observation_anchor,advice_created_at). Exact half-life multiples use exact rational division; nonmultiples use local Decimal precision 80; age>=64H gives zero.
numerical_laws.time_limits: valid_from inclusive; valid_to exclusive; independent expiry at advice_created_at+TTL and age>=604800. Decay-to-zero USABLE is distinct from EXPIRED_NOT_CONSUMABLE.
numerical_laws.review: USABLE review pressure=Q-T; additional review recommended iff T<600000000. Equality does not trigger this recommendation; mandatory checks always remain. Unusable/cold advice retains maximal pressure.
numerical_laws.AVF: eta=62500000; beta=250000000; Signal=2Y-Q; P_next=clamp(P+RHE(eta*(Signal-P)/Q),-Q,Q); Delta=RHE(beta*P/Q); Adjusted=clamp(Base+Delta,0,Q); Root micros=RHE(Adjusted*1000000/Q).
numerical_laws.bounds: At most 256 delivered audit rows and 64 distinct effective occurrences; exact duplicates count once, conflicts fail closed; 3 events is WARM counting state only. Missing/ineligible E or outcome gives NO_UPDATE, never fabricated zero.
